product_one_liner.value: SER Group’s Doxis platform helps enterprises classify, extract, understand and centralize documents, automate workflows and reduce manual work.

pricing_page.notes: Lists licensing options and Business, Enterprise and Unlimited cloud editions.

employee_band.notes: No permitted band fits: the company reports more than 900 employees on https://www.doxis.com/en/about-us.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows business, product and educational articles, not two qualifying engineer-authored posts about building the product.

public_docs.notes: Public Doxis AI.dp documentation includes multiple product guides, component articles and an API reference.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live Full Stack AI Engineer posting in Groningen, Netherlands, hiring three engineers at Klippa, a Doxis company.

model_provider.notes: Doxis AI.dp documentation lists these as supported, configurable providers rather than identifying one mandatory backend.

compliance_certs.notes: SOC 2 applies to Doxis Cloud Services; the company describes Doxis as EU GDPR-certified.

last_funding.notes: Strategic growth investment from TA Associates announced March 21, 2024; amount undisclosed.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified funding round was March 21, 2024, outside the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live postings include Business Development Representative in London and Account Executive for the Nordics, both with application links.

launched_6mo.notes: On June 17, 2026, Doxis unveiled Ask Doxi, a context-aware AI assistant, and Agent Manager for creating and governing enterprise AI agents.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The January 19, 2026 announcement names Andy Spence as the incoming Chief Revenue Officer.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The BDR posting explicitly requires regularly maintaining and expanding data in Salesforce.
